limitations: OS-owned iOS Files and Add to Home Screen dialogs cannot be rendered by the web app; documented as manual real-device steps, not fabricated.
VoiceOver output needs a physical iPhone; automated accessibility tree and keyboard checks only.
Swiping/dragging evidence is captured at desktop where behaviour differs; same screenshot IDs use the equivalent available interaction on mobile.
An inventory state is not certified captured until present in capture-manifest results. Failed scenario groups are recorded explicitly.
